data.one_liner: Perform build-time assertions on constants so misconfigured apps fail at compilation.
data.what_it_does: Provides an @Assert annotation to validate constant values at build time. It ensures that apps with invalid configurations fail to compile rather than failing at runtime.
use_when: You configure your app using const values and environment variables.
You want to catch configuration errors during compilation instead of runtime.
avoid_when: You need dynamic runtime configuration validation.
strengths: Requires meaningful error messages for assertions.
weaknesses: Expected to be deprecated when Dart natively supports metaprogramming.
